data.title: Staff Engineer (f/m/d) AI
data.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

Your Mission at plancraft

We're building plancraft towards an agentic-first product experience. That means AI-enabled capabilities our customers actually use: features that take real administrative work off a tradesperson's plate and hold up under production load, day after day.

Building AI-enabled products that work reliably at scale requires strong engineering foundations. You'll help shape those foundations — from architecture and system design to engineering practices — while keeping the focus on what we're ultimately building for our customers.

This is an individual contributor role with no disciplinary leadership but significant influence across Engineering. You'll work hands-on where it matters, shape technical direction across teams, and help other engineers build better systems.

We have a clear vision for how we want to build software and the outcomes we want to achieve, while recognising that we're still on the journey to get there. Some foundations are already in place; others are still evolving. We're looking for someone who has built and scaled complex systems before and can bring that experience into what we build.

Our customers are tradespeople. Every hour they spend on paperwork is an hour off the job site. We keep that in mind when making technical decisions: the systems we build should ultimately help us take more work off their plate.

Your Responsibilities

  • AI-enabled product capabilities. You'll help define what AI can meaningfully do for our customers and turn emerging capabilities into reliable, observable product experiences that work beyond the demo.

  • The wider technical system. Together with our other Staff Engineers, you'll shape architectural direction and the properties that should hold across teams, while enabling individual teams to build and ship independently.

  • Data foundations for AI-enabled workflows. You’ll help turn product and business data into meaningful signals, insights, and context that AI can use reliably in customer-facing workflows — from defining the right data models and semantics, and drawing a clear line between operational data and knowledge, to making that understanding available where it creates real product value.

  • How we build with AI. You'll influence both how we develop and evaluate customer-facing AI capabilities and how AI changes software engineering itself — from tooling and workflows to standards and practices across the organisation.

How you'll work & influence

We have clear engineering principles, but we expect our Staff Engineers to challenge and evolve them. We favour small, integrated changes, observable systems that recover quickly, explicit architectural boundaries, and engineering decisions that are encoded rather than repeatedly debated. Above all, engineers own customer problems — not tickets.

You'll have meaningful autonomy from the start:

  • Shape technical direction. You'll evolve shared architecture and engineering standards through RFCs and ADRs, not by waiting for top-down decisions.

  • Own complex initiatives end to end. From discovery and technical design through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Influence where Engineering invests. You'll help identify the technical capabilities, architectural improvements, and engineering practices worth investing in.

  • Raise the bar across teams. You'll shape architecture, developer experience, AI-enabled engineering practices, and codebase quality beyond your immediate team.

  • Multiply other engineers. You'll mentor through collaboration, architectural guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

How hands-on you are depends on the problem. Some weeks you'll be deep in the code; others you'll focus on system design, technical discovery, or mentoring across teams. We care about the technical outcomes you create, not your commit count.

Your Profile

  • AI- and agentic-build competencies. You have designed, built, shipped, or operated AI-enabled or agentic product systems beyond prompts alone: retrieval and knowledge design, evaluation of non-deterministic behaviour, observability of model- and tool-driven flows, and debugging across multi-step agent traces. You know what it takes to move these systems from promising demos into reliable product experiences, and you can help others build the judgement to use them safely.

  • Experience building and operating real production systems. You've designed, shipped, and lived with complex systems at scale — whether distributed architectures, asynchronous or multi-step workflows, event-driven services, data pipelines, or ETL pipelines. You understand reliability and observability because you've needed them in practice. You bring 5+ years of software engineering experience and a track record of technical leadership.

  • Strong typed-language fundamentals — and a polyglot mindset. You understand the concepts that make a strong type system valuable and use them to keep a growing codebase understandable and maintainable. Our stack is React on the frontend, serverless Node.js / Express on the backend, and GCP underneath — all TypeScript, so you're either productive in TypeScript or able to get there quickly. Where your deepest expertise sits matters less: if that's Rust, Go, Kotlin, or something else, we see it as a strength. Having worked across several languages and paradigms tends to reduce stack bias exactly when systems thinking matters most. Experience with another modern cloud environment is absolutely fine.

  • Information systems thinking. You distinguish clearly between operational data and knowledge — the transactional state that runs the business versus the modelled, contextual understanding that AI-enabled workflows depend on — and you design deliberately for both. In an agentic product, that distinction is a practical necessity, not a theoretical one.

  • Strong system design and domain modelling skills. You know how to create clear boundaries, model business concepts explicitly, and design systems that can evolve without every change becoming expensive. Techniques such as dependency injection, adapters, making invalid states unrepresentable, and parse-don’t-validate are tools you’ve applied rather than concepts you’ve only read about.

  • Strong product thinking. You start with the problem rather than the technology, use evidence to understand customer needs, and make deliberate trade-offs between technical excellence, speed, and product outcomes.

  • Technical leadership beyond your own work. You've influenced technical direction across teams, mentored other engineers, and can align Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • AI is already part of how you work. You use tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex seriously, understand where they help and where they don't, and can help others adopt them effectively.

  • A T-shaped engineering profile. You bring broad engineering judgment across product and system challenges, with genuine depth in at least one area.

  • C1 English. German is a plus, not a must.

Deep production engineering experience and the ability to apply it to AI-enabled products matter more than expertise in a specific model or framework.

Who this role is for

This role is for someone who wants to operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical influence — without people management. You won’t be the only Staff Engineer: we currently have four Staff Engineers and are looking for great additions to the group. You’ll work closely with Engineering Managers who steward people, team environment and flow while you steward the technical system and direction.

You’ll enjoy this role if you like moving across product, architecture, engineering practices and AI-enabled ways of working — and if you prefer shaping systems and standards across teams over specialising deeply in one narrow technology or domain.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. data.title: Data Analyst (m/f/d)
data.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.
  • Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured.
  • Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation.
  • Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured.
  • Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. Communicate effectively across different levels and functions, from discussing detailed data questions with technical teams to presenting clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for datasets, transformations, metrics, and data lineage using dbt Docs or similar tools, and contribute to practical standards for SQL, data modelling, testing, and visualisation.
  • Automation & AI: Identify manual or inefficient analytical workflows and improve them through automation, modern data tooling, and AI-assisted analysis - using AI to accelerate data exploration, querying, documentation, and reporting while maintaining a strong understanding of and control over the underlying data.


YOUR PROFILE

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Business Analytics, or a closely related analytical role, with a track record of turning complex business questions and raw data into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and business decisions
  • Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes, define meaningful metrics, challenge assumptions, and work confidently with imperfect or incomplete data
  • Independent, structured, and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership. You are equally comfortable working with business stakeholders and engineers, communicate clearly across different levels and functions, and can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You are also genuinely curious about AI-assisted analytics and modern cloud data workflows, while maintaining full control of and understanding of the underlying data
  • Strong business understanding and analytical curiosity, with the ability to quickly grasp the essentials of a complex, finance-driven business, understand how the underlying processes work, and translate business needs into meaningful analytical questions. Experience with financials, commodity trading, finance analytics, or accounting is a strong advantage
  • Strong SQL skills with experience working with complex datasets, data transformations, joins, aggregations, window functions, and analytical data models
  • Proven experience working with modern Data Warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or similar, including building and maintaining clean, reliable datasets for analysis and reporting
  • Experience with modern analytics engineering practices and tools such as dbt, including data modelling, automated data quality tests, documentation, and data lineage
  • Strong experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar), with a focus on building clear, performant dashboards and enabling self-service analytics


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location
  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment

data.title: Haleon PTA (m/w/d) als Trainer im Außendienst, Hamburg
data.description:
Dein Job

Du bist PTA und möchtest dein pharmazeutisches Fachwissen nicht nur anwenden, sondern gezielt weitergeben und echten Mehrwert schaffen?

Du suchst eine Rolle, in der du Menschen überzeugst, Wissen vermittelst und nachhaltige Ergebnisse erzielst.
Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und unterstütze die Haleon Markenwelt rund um Voltaren, Fenistil und Vitasprint.
In dieser abwechslungsreichen Rolle genießt du Benefits wie Firmenwagen, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Tagesschichten und keine Wochenendarbeit.


Deine Aufgaben – vielseitig und eigenverantwortlich:

  • Trainings und Wissensvermittlung:
    Planung und Durchführung von Vor-Ort-Trainings in Apotheken sowie vertiefender Schulungen zu Produkt- und Verkaufsthemen.
  • Produktexpertise:
    Vermittlung fundierten Wissens zur Haleon Markenwelt (u. a. Voltaren, Fenistil, Vitasprint) sowie Unterstützung bei der optimalen Platzierung und Präsentation im Handverkauf und Sichtwahlbereich.
  • Qualitäts- & Kompetenzentwicklung:
    Nachhaltige Weiterentwicklung der Beratungsqualität im Apothekenteam mit dem Ziel, die aktive Empfehlung am Point of Sale zu stärken.
  • Markt- & Wettbewerbsbeobachtung:
    Kontinuierliche Analyse von Marktentwicklungen, Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und Trends im Apothekenumfeld sowie Einbringung relevanter Insights ins Team.
  • Projektarbeit & Weiterentwicklung:
    Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung von Trainingskonzepten, Webinaren und weiteren Lernformaten sowie kontinuierlicher Ausbau der eigenen fachlichen Expertise.


Warum du bei uns arbeiten solltest:

  • Work-Life-Balance: 
    Freue dich auf feste Arbeitszeiten ohne Schichtdienst und Wochenendarbeit, zusätzliche freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester sowie flexibler Gestaltungsspielraum für deinen Arbeitsalltag.
  • Mobiles Arbeiten & Ausstattung: 
     Im Außendienst sind unsere Teams mit Tablet und Smartphone bestens ausgestattet, um jederzeit und überall einsatzbereit zu sein. Mit einem Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte, der auch privat genutzt werden kann, sorgen wir dafür, dass der Point of Sale schnell und sicher erreicht werden kann.
  • Sicherheit & Wachstum: 
     Als Deutschlands größte inhabergeführte Sales und Retail Agentur bieten wir dir langfristig einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz.
  • Corporate Benefits: 
     Wir arbeiten für die großen Marken und Händler. Über unsere Corporate Benefits kannst du attraktive Rabatte für ausgewählte Marken.
  • Was uns auszeichnet:  
     Wir stehen für Toleranz, Offenheit, Respekt und Integrität – Werte, die Vielfalt fördern und ein vertrauensvolles Miteinander stärken. Mit Freude, Mut und Verantwortung schaffen wir eine inspirierende Kultur, die Innovation und nachhaltiges Handeln vereint.
  • Onboarding-Days: 
     Wir laden dich in unser Office ein, geben dir einen Überblick über deinen Joballtag, stellen dir die wichtigsten Ansprechpartner vor und lassen dich die TMS-Kultur hautnah erleben!


Deine Stärken und Skills:

  • Fachliche Qualifikation & Erfahrung:
    Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als PTA bildet die Grundlage, ergänzt idealerweise durch erste Erfahrungen im Training, in der Beratung oder im Außendienst.
  • Fachkompetenz & Branchenverständnis:
    Fundiertes pharmazeutisches Wissen, gutes Verständnis regulatorischer Anforderungen sowie Kenntnisse des Apothekenmarkts und betriebswirtschaftlicher Zusammenhänge.
  • Kommunikation & Präsentationsstärke:
    Sicheres Auftreten, ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, Inhalte verständlich und zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln.
  • Arbeitsweise & Mobilität:
    Strukturierte, eigenständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit gutem Zeitmanagement und hoher Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Region (inklusive Führerschein Klasse B).
  • Lernbereitschaft & Weiterentwicklung:
    Hohe Motivation zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung, regelmäßige Teilnahme an Trainings und Fachveranstaltungen sowie eigenständige Erweiterung des fachlichen und vertrieblichen Know-hows.

Über uns

teamative bietet Beratung, Entwicklung und die Umsetzung von IT‑Projekten in Europa und den USA.
 
Mit SAP und ServiceNow als Kernkompetenzen sowie maßgeschneiderter Softwareentwicklung und DevOps helfen wir dabei, Prozesse zu vereinfachen, digitale Lösungen zu implementieren und komplexe Transformationsinitiativen erfolgreich zu steuern. Darüber hinaus ermöglichen wir flexibles Staffing, damit Teams je nach Anforderung schnell angepasst werden können.
 
Rund 400 interne Mitarbeitende und insgesamt mehr als 750 Expert:innen verbinden bei teamative tiefe Inhouse‑Expertise mit bedarfsorientierter Staff Augmentation – sichtbar in langfristigen, vertrauensvollen Partnerschaften mit renommierten Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen.
 
So stehen wir seit über 20 Jahren für Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Kosteneffizienz – in Stuttgart, Bratislava, Miami und über zehn europäischen Tech Hubs.


Stellenintro

Als Senior SAP SD Consultant begleitest du unsere Kunden bei der Optimierung ihrer Vertriebsprozesse und der Transformation auf SAP S/4HANA. Du analysierst komplexe Anforderungen, entwickelst passende SAP-Lösungen und sorgst dafür, dass Prozesse vom Auftrag bis zur Fakturierung effizient und durchgängig funktionieren.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Optimiere Vertriebsprozesse: Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse im SAP SD und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden effiziente und zukunftsfähige Lösungen für ihre Vertriebsorganisation. 
  • Gestalte S/4HANA-Transformationen: Du begleitest Kunden fachlich und technisch bei der Einführung, Migration und Weiterentwicklung von SAP S/4HANA Sales. 
  • Verbessere End-to-End-Prozesse: Du gestaltest und optimierst den gesamten Order-to-Cash-Prozess – von Auftrag und Lieferung bis hin zu Fakturierung und Übergabe an Finance. 
  • Verbinde SAP-Prozesse: Du stellst eine reibungslose Integration von SAP SD mit FI, CO, MM und weiteren angrenzenden Bereichen sicher. 
  • Mache Anforderungen zu Lösungen: Du analysierst fachliche Anforderungen, führst Kundenworkshops durch und übersetzt Geschäftsprozesse in passende SAP-Lösungen. 
  • Übernimm Verantwortung: Du steuerst Arbeitspakete oder Teilprojekte eigenständig und unterstützt unsere Bestandskunden bei SAP-SD-Support, Prozessoptimierung und Weiterentwicklung. 


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als SAP SD Consultant, SAP Sales Consultant oder SAP Key User mit fundiertem Verständnis von Vertriebsprozessen. 
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP SD sowie idealerweise praktische Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA Sales. 
  • Gutes Verständnis des Order-to-Cash-Prozesses und idealerweise Erfahrung mit Themen wie Auftragserfassung, Lieferabwicklung, Versand, Fakturierung und Preisfindung. 
  • Verständnis für die Integration von SAP SD mit FI, CO und MM sowie angrenzenden End-to-End-Prozessen. 
  • Erfahrung in Kundenberatung, Anforderungsanalyse, Workshop-Moderation und Präsentation sowie die Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare SAP-Lösungen zu übersetzen. 
  • Eigenständige und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse; projektabhängige Reisebereitschaft.

data.description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

You'll be a force multiplier for the Pre-sales organization. You'll own how Zip demos end to end: the environments, data, scripts, and certification standards that let any Solution Engineer deliver a technically credible demo quickly and consistently. You will be responsible for developing the solution demo frameworks, reusable assets, and self-service approach that every Solution Engineer and Account Executive benefits from.

You’ll work closely with Solution Engineering leadership, Enterprise Architecture, Product, and Product Marketing to design our demos of the future. This is a hands-on builder role, not a maintenance seat. You're building the systems and vision for what a great demo looks like at Zip.

What You'll Do

  • Own demo environment build and operations: Design, build, and maintain the demo environments, data sets, demo pathways, and demo scripts every SEs uses.

  • Build self-service tooling and templates: Turn demo-builds into packages assets that SEs and AEs can pull directly.

  • Shape our demo narratives and storytelling: Develop the talk tracks, narrative arcs, and messaging that turn technical features into a story every SE can tell.

  • Keep demo assets in lockstep with releases: Partner with Product and Product Marketing so new agents, integrations, and vertical use cases ship with a working demo environment and script.

  • Automate scripting and asset generation with AI: Use LLMs and AI coding tools to generate and maintain demo scripts, synthetic data, and environment scaffolding, cutting manual build time on every new demo asset.

  • Automate end-to-end demo workflows with Playwright: Script and maintain Playwright-based flows that walk through full demo scenarios automatically, so environments get validated and refreshed without manual QA.

  • Build with AI-native development tools: Prototype and ship internal tooling using tools like Replit and Lovable, taking new demo assets from idea to working build.

  • Build and maintain agentic loops: Design agent workflows that can prepare, validate, and repair demo environments on their own, catching broken flows before an SE does.

Qualifications

  • 2–5+ years in technical pre-sales, sales engineering, or demo engineering at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.

  • Real hands-on build skills: scripting fluency (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar), comfort with REST APIs and webhooks, and enough cloud/infrastructure familiarity (AWS, GCP, or Azure) to stand up and operate a demo environment without waiting on engineering.

  • Hands-on experience using AI to automate scripting and asset generation

  • Experience automating end-to-end workflows with Playwright or a comparable browser-automation framework, for demo environment validation, regression testing, or scripted walkthroughs.

  • Direct experience building with AI-native development tools such as Replit, Lovable, or similar. Comfortable going from a blank canvas to a working prototype largely through AI-assisted building.

  • Experience designing and maintaining agentic loops: multi-step AI agent workflows that execute, evaluate, and self-correct.

  • A systems thinker who can tell the difference between fixing the one-off request in front of them and building the thing that prevents the next ten.

  • Strong storytelling instincts: you know the difference between a feature tour and a demo that lands, and you can teach that difference to other people.

  • A strong cross-functional operator: you'll work daily with SE leadership, Product, PMM, and Enterprise Architecture, and you know how to get alignment without a committee.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling into procurement, finance, or supply chain functions.

  • Familiarity with ERP and enterprise systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, ServiceNow) and how they intersect with procurement technology, for cross-system demo integrations.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Health, vision & dental coverage

  • Commuter benefit

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 💻 Apple equipment plus home office stipend

  • 5% Employer Pension Contribution

We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

Zip is looking for a highly motivated, outgoing, and tech-savvy sales representative with strong business acumen to join our growing Business Development team. As a Business Development Representative, you will generate new business by prospecting outbound leads through cold outreach and work collaboratively across our sales organization to set high-value meetings. Joining the Business Development team is an opportunity to fast-track your career in sales. Applicants should have a growth mindset and be excited to work collaboratively across the Revenue organization. You will learn consultative selling and hone in on our best-in-class outbound motion to execute our sales strategy. High performers in the BDR role will open up new opportunities for career growth within our rapidly growing organization.

We’re looking for a customer-focused, highly motivated, and driven individual with a desire to grow and advance in a career in sales. If you have a proactive and customer-first mentality with the passion to demonstrate Zip’s commitment to our merchants, we’d love to talk to you!

  • Partner closely with our VP of Sales and Account Executives to identify and source meetings that lead to pipeline and closed revenue

  • Prospect across a high volume of accounts, with a keen eye on strategically prioritizing your time

  • An ability to celebrate change and embrace accountability

  • Gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization

  • Partner with the Director of Business Development on key success metrics for your role and how you will measure against them

  • Partner with the Director of Business Development to discuss your personal and professional goals

  • Begin developing familiarity with our business, platform, and applications, as well as our company’s key metrics

  • Manage follow-up with calls-to-action to consistently build a sales pipeline

Within 2 months, you will...

Achieve department standards for activity that includes:

  • Making a minimum number of quality outbound calls per day

  • Scheduling a minimum number of new quality discovery calls per week

  • Become a market expert by researching and understanding our target industries and personas

  • Consistently reflect on your own skill and development gaps along with the Director of Business Development to identify personal and professional goals

  • Become a mentor to new hires entering into the Business Development organization

  • Become a key stakeholder in Zip’s growth as we continue to scale our core business

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

data.title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
data.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams.

This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities.

The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers, along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers and work closely with teams across:

  • Customer Support

  • Customer Onboarding

  • Sales and Account Management

  • Product and Product Operations

  • Revenue Operations

  • Finance

  • Data and Analytics

  • Program Management and Operations

You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership.

You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will:

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment.

  • Develop detailed customer success plans that connect the customer’s strategic goals to measurable outcomes, adoption milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.

  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic customer meetings that demonstrate value, address risks, align stakeholders, and create clear next steps.

  • Drive product adoption across complex customer organisations, helping customers expand usage across teams, entities, locations, use cases, and workflows.

  • Create and maintain detailed stakeholder maps, identifying decision-makers, champions, influencers, operational contacts, blockers, and executive sponsors.

  • Identify churn risk early using product usage, engagement, stakeholder, support, financial, organisational, and external business signals.

  • Build and execute churn-prevention plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, customer commitments, and executive escalation paths.

  • Maintain detailed and accurate forecasts across renewals, risk, customer health, expected outcomes, growth opportunities, and major account milestones.

  • Lead renewal-readiness activities by ensuring customer value is documented, risks are addressed, stakeholders are aligned, and commercial partners have accurate account intelligence.

  • Identify and support expansion opportunities by connecting additional Pleo capabilities, products, or use cases to the customer’s evolving business needs.

  • Coordinate complex customer escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams while maintaining clear and confident customer communication.

  • Act as the customer’s internal advocate, ensuring customer needs, feedback, risks, and opportunities are visible to the right stakeholders at Pleo.

  • Navigate customer change effectively, including leadership transitions, reorganisations, acquisitions, market expansion, platform changes, and evolving business priorities.

  • Track customer commitments and outcomes with strong operational discipline, ensuring actions are documented, owned, and completed.

  • Contribute to the evolution of Pleo’s enterprise Customer Success model by sharing best practices, customer insights, playbooks, and recommendations.

  • Support peer development and knowledge sharing across the Customer Success team without holding direct people-management responsibility.

To put things into context

In this role, you can expect to work on priorities such as:

  • strengthening relationships with Pleo’s largest and most strategic customers

  • improving enterprise customer retention and renewal predictability

  • increasing adoption across complex customer organisations

  • creating stronger executive engagement and governance

  • identifying churn risk before it becomes a renewal issue

  • improving forecast accuracy and account visibility

  • coordinating complex customer needs across multiple internal teams

  • helping customers quantify and communicate the value they receive from Pleo

  • identifying opportunities for expansion and deeper product adoption

  • improving the consistency and quality of enterprise success planning

  • helping customers navigate operational and organisational change

  • turning customer feedback into actionable Product and CX insight

You can expect to work across a technology environment that includes CRM, Customer Success platforms, support systems, product analytics, business intelligence tools, workflow tools, and collaboration platforms.

Examples may include Vitally, Gainsight or similar, Zendesk, Looker, Tableau or Power BI, Jira, Asana, and Slack.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • At least three years of direct enterprise Customer Success or strategic account-management experience, managing large, complex, and high-value B2B customers.

  • Five or more years of overall experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or a related customer-facing role.

  • Experience working in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B technology environment.

  • A proven record of retaining and growing enterprise customers, including managing renewals, adoption, risk, and value realisation.

  • Strong executive relationship-management skills, with the confidence and credibility to engage senior decision-makers and business leaders.

  • Experience managing complex stakeholder environments involving multiple teams, business units, regions, entities, or decision-makers.

  • Strong churn-prediction and prevention skills, including the ability to interpret customer signals, identify root causes, and build effective recovery plans.

  • Detailed forecasting experience across renewals, customer risk, account health, adoption, and expansion opportunities.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with an understanding of how customer outcomes connect to retention, revenue, expansion, and long-term account value.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to lead difficult conversations, present to executives, and simplify complex issues.

  • Experience managing accounts with complex security, compliance, governance, or implementation requirements

Why is this role a good fit for you?

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You enjoy building strategic relationships with complex enterprise customers.

  • You are comfortable engaging senior leaders and navigating high-stakes customer situations.

  • You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes.

  • You are proactive about identifying and addressing churn risk.

  • You combine strong relationship skills with rigorous account-management discipline.

  • You are confident leading executive reviews, renewal discussions, and difficult customer conversations.

  • You enjoy coordinating internal teams around complex customer needs.

  • You want direct responsibility for protecting and growing some of Pleo’s most important customer relationships.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You have not directly managed enterprise or strategic customer relationships.

  • You prefer transactional or high-volume customer portfolios.

  • You are uncomfortable owning customer risk, retention, and renewal readiness.

  • You prefer reacting to customer requests rather than building proactive engagement strategies.

  • You are uncomfortable engaging executive stakeholders or leading difficult conversations.

  • You do not enjoy detailed forecasting, CRM management, and account planning.

  • You prefer working independently without significant cross-functional coordination.

  • You are looking for a people-management role rather than a senior individual-contributor position.

How you’ll develop in this role

  • Build a detailed understanding of your customer portfolio, including revenue, renewal dates, usage, stakeholders, open issues, risks, and growth potential.

  • Review and improve success plans, stakeholder maps, account plans, and risk assessments.

  • Establish clear operating rhythms for customer engagement, internal coordination, and forecasting.

In your first 3 months, you’ll:

  • Lead consistent executive and operational engagement across your customer portfolio.

  • Improve customer success planning, value documentation, and renewal readiness.

  • Strengthen the accuracy and detail of customer health and renewal forecasts.

  • Deliver measurable progress against adoption, engagement, and customer outcome goals.

  • Build and execute mitigation plans for at-risk customers.

  • Identify and support qualified expansion opportunities.

  • Become a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders and a reliable source of account intelligence internally.

In your first 5 months, you’ll:

  • Build a healthy and well-managed portfolio of enterprise customers.

  • Deliver strong retention and renewal performance.

  • Improve adoption and value realisation across complex customer organisations.

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders.

  • Demonstrate strong forecast accuracy and proactive risk management.

  • Contribute repeatable best practices and insight to Pleo’s broader enterprise Customer Success model.

  • Be recognised as a senior individual contributor capable of managing Pleo’s most important and complex customer relationships.

Success in this role looks like

  • Enterprise customers have clear success plans connected to measurable business outcomes.

  • Executive and operational customer relationships are strong and multi-threaded.

  • Customer risks are identified early and addressed through structured mitigation plans.

  • Renewal forecasts are detailed, accurate, and supported by clear account evidence.

  • Customers demonstrate stronger product adoption and value realisation.

  • Escalations are managed with urgency, clarity, and strong customer communication.

  • Internal teams are aligned around customer priorities, responsibilities, and next steps.

  • Renewal and retention performance is strong across the assigned portfolio.

  • Expansion opportunities are identified through customer value and business need rather than transactional selling.

  • Pleo is viewed as a strategic partner rather than simply a product provider.

Candidate profile summary

The strongest candidate for this role is an experienced enterprise Customer Success professional who combines senior-level relationship skills with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and disciplined account execution.

They have at least three years of direct enterprise experience and are comfortable managing complex customers with multiple stakeholders, high expectations, and significant revenue impact.

They know how to earn executive trust, demonstrate value, predict and prevent churn, maintain accurate forecasts, and mobilise cross-functional teams around customer outcomes. We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't.

Every process change, every new product line runs into SAP systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.

data.title: Sales Engineer
data.description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

About the role

We are looking for a sales engineer to join our sales team and drive the frontline of industrial decarbonisation.

This role bridges the technical and commercial worlds. You'll need interpersonal and technical skills to build relationships with process engineers in cement plants and understand their challenges. Analytical skills will be essential to delve deep into complex plant data and work out how Gigaton's AI products can solve their most critical issues.

Building on that, you'll need strategic thinking and commercial awareness to turn your findings into concise, compelling proposals for decision-makers at our customers, from the C-suite down.

Ultimately, you'll build clarity from uncertainty, making sure we agree a shared roadmap with our customers that puts our solutions on track for significant real-world benefits before a contract is signed.

Over time, you’ll help us evolve our sales approach and shape the product by feeding insights and needs from the plant back to the product team, building the foundation for scaling across industries.

Your main responsibilities

  • Be the technical expert on sales calls and visits with cement plants.

  • Build trust with process engineers and plant teams by understanding their specific plant issues and linking them to how we can help.

  • Analyse plant data to identify and evaluate opportunities, then use this analysis to create compelling sales proposals.

  • Lead technical discovery and identify early when a plant does not meet our ICP (ideal customer profile) criteria.

  • Make sure relationships and plant understanding are handed over successfully to the deployment team.

  • Act as a feedback loop into Gigaton’s product and machine learning teams, providing field insights that help shape our product roadmap.

  • Develop and iterate the pre-sales technical process, making it more impactful and more automated each time.

  • Travel to plants and conferences, around one week per month, to understand customer environments and explain the product.

What a great fit looks like

  • Exposure to physical sciences, controls, or heavy industry, such as cement, steel, energy, manufacturing, or similar.

  • Strong analytical skills and an outcome-oriented mindset. You can dig into industrial data, identify root causes, generate potential solutions, and explain their value in dollars and tonnes of CO2.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can build credibility and trust in complex industrial environments with both engineers and board-level stakeholders.

  • Comfortable being the technical voice in the conversation, presenting to senior plant leaders and operators, handling objections, and being challenged on your findings by people who have run kilns for 30 years.

  • Naturally curious and keen to learn about the industry, the technology, and each individual plant. You want to understand the root cause behind every question and objection so you can solve the right problem.

  • Confident in ambiguity and able to field very specific technical questions without getting flustered. You know when you can give your understanding, when you need to go and find the answer, and how to maintain customer confidence in both situations.

  • Willingness to travel regularly.

You’ll excel if

  • You build trust easily. You can connect with plant engineers, listen deeply, and align solutions to their priorities.

  • You’d rather diagnose than pitch. Your first instinct in a plant is to ask a better question, not to open the deck.

  • You thrive in dynamic environments. Fast-paced, ambiguous settings excite you, and you’re motivated by high-impact, mission-driven work.

  • You have experience working in heavy industry, particularly cement, steel, energy, heavy manufacturing, or similar.

Success in This Role Means

  • Plants say yes because the technical case is clear. You build customer confidence that Gigaton can deliver high ROI, helping us hit our revenue goals without losing deals because customers don’t understand or believe in our product and capabilities.

  • Deployments are set up to succeed. We haven’t overpromised to sign a contract, and our pre-contract analysis holds up once the system is live.

  • Process engineers trust and rely on you as a partner in solving problems.

  • Deals don’t stall waiting on a technical answer. Objections get handled quickly, and customers get the answers they need in good time.

    💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.

    We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from all walks of life, with different countries, cultures, and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.

    We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.

The interview process

  1. Talent Partner Screen Call: Meet our talent partner and learn more about Gigaton and the role.

  2. Hiring Manager Screen: Meet our VP of Sales and discuss if this role is a good fit for you.

  3. Technical Onsite (completed on the same day):

    1. Technical interview

    2. Data analysis & presentation

  4. Operating Principles Interview: Understand how we work and whether Gigaton and you are a good fit for each other.

  5. Meet with the CEO: Every new potential hire meets Josh.

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll reference-check candidates before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us by chatting to team members you haven’t yet met. Ask anything. We’ll answer with Concrete Honesty.

Once interviews are done, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to give feedback at any stage.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership: High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun: Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page.

As a Commercial CSM, you're the partner to our mid-market engineering teams - getting them onboarded, embedded and expanding their usage, and maturing their incident management and reliability as they grow.

What that looks like day to day

Our Customer Success organisation is at the heart of incident.io. We're the team closest to our customers' hardest problems, and we're trusted to solve them. We believe in a customer-led product approach, working hand in hand with Product to uncover and address what each customer really needs. Our goal goes beyond satisfaction: we want to delight customers at every stage of their journey, and build long-term relationships grounded in trust, shared success and mutual growth.

You'll look after 70–80 Commercial customers: growth-oriented tech companies, mostly under 1,000 people, between $30k and $150k ARR each. Industry leaders like Vanta, Monday.com and Loom sit in this segment. Some are steady, some are scaling fast, and much of the job is knowing which is which, and what each one needs from you.

Most of your time goes to mid-market customers on our top-tier plan, where you're their dedicated CSM leading onboarding and adoption. You'll blend 1:1 time with scalable programmes to get teams to value quickly: best-practice sessions, end-user training, partnership and roadmap reviews. You'll also cover a subset of smaller customers in a low-touch capacity, leaning on usage data to spot risk and opportunity early.

Day to day, this is a high ownership role. You'll help customers navigate the product, unpick problems when they hit them, and keep everyone pointed at the outcomes their team actually cares about. You are responsible for proactively identifying expansion and upsell opportunities, and partnering with Sales and Expansion Account Managers to grow revenue within your accounts. Internally, you're the voice of the Commercial customer with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Support.

There's still a lot to build and a ton of opportunity for you to shape this segment. The Commercial motion works, but scaling and automating the customer journey is live work we're ramping up now - refining playbooks, automating the repeatable stuff, building the tooling and content that makes a portfolio this size easier to serve. We're AI-forward in how we approach it, so you'd be shaping this rather than inheriting it.

Who you are

  • You've carried a book of 40 to 100+ accounts and worked out how to be present across all of them without going quiet on half.

  • You've sold to, or supported, technical people, whether that's engineering teams, on-call rotations or developer tools. You can hold your own in a technical conversation without needing to escalate every one of them.

  • You've got commercial instincts. You spot the account that's about to double, you know what a growth signal looks like, and you know how to steer a renewal to a good outcome.

  • You know what scaled CS looks like when it's done well. Playbooks, one-to-many programs, AI-assisted workflows. You don't need to have built them from scratch, but you've worked around them enough to have opinions on what you'd do differently.

  • Half-built process doesn't rattle you. You'd rather fix the documentation than complain about it.

  • You actually like being in a room with customers, and you'll get on a plane for the right one.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover — we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £75K – £100K • Offers Commission

PLEASE NOTE: This is a hybrid role and requires employees to be based within 35 miles of our London office. You will be expected to work on-site two days a week, on Tuesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days.

The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us!

The Impact You'll Have

  • Build Product Expertise: Develop deep knowledge of specific Marqeta products and services; create customer slide presentations,  internal runbooks and training content to scale team knowledge.

  • Comfortable working across teams and building relationships with both clients and internal stakeholders.

  • A customer-first mindset; skilled at understanding customer needs and designing practical solutions.

  • Strategic thinker who can connect daily work to broader business goals and team priorities.

  • Commitment to learning and contributing to the growth of others on the team.

  • Ability to prioritise, manage, and deliver on multiple projects simultaneously; highly motivated and able to work unsupervised against aggressive schedules.

  • Familiarity with APIs, software integrations, or payments systems.

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values

– Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA
data.description:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

 

About the role

Forward Deployed Engineers are the technical tip of the spear at Exa. Partnered with an Account Executive, you own the technical win: you run discovery with customer engineering teams, design solutions on Exa's API, build and deliver demos and POCs that prove value, and turn technical evaluations into closed deals. You'll be one of the first GTM engineers in your region — you'll help define how Exa sells there, not just execute a playbook.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical side of the sales cycle: discovery, solution design, demos, POCs/POVs, and technical objection handling, in partnership with your AE

  • Run the technical side of expansion: spot new use cases in existing accounts and turn them into evaluations, with your AE

  • Build working demos and prototypes on Exa's API tailored to each customer's use case — agents, research, search, enrichment

  • Tell the story: translate Exa's capabilities into use-case narratives that land with CTOs, engineers, and PMs alike

  • Be the trusted technical advisor: know Exa inside out — the product, the API, the problems it solves — answer hard questions honestly, run evaluations rigorously, and know when to pull in engineering

  • Feed the field back into product: identify patterns across customer evaluations and channel them to product and engineering

  • Scale yourself and the region: build reusable demos, integration patterns, and playbooks, and represent Exa at technical workshops, meetups, and conferences

  • As a founding regional hire, support early customers through onboarding and initial implementation while we build out dedicated post-sales

Requirements

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role (flexible for exceptional candidates) — solutions/sales engineering, solutions architecture, or an engineering role with heavy customer exposure (e.g., engineering lead, developer relations, technical consulting)

  • Technical depth with APIs and modern development (e.g. Python or TypeScript): you can design an integration, build a working demo, and debug it live — using AI-assisted tooling is expected, hand-crafted code is not the bar

  • Strong communication and presentation skills: you can command a room, adapt to your audience, and say "I don't know — I'll find out" when you don't

  • Comfort with ambiguity and early-stage intensity: you can run several evaluations in parallel, prioritize what moves deals, and your job description will change as the region grows

  • Familiarity with the modern AI stack — LLMs, RAG, agents — and how customers evaluate it; you can scope a POC with clear success criteria

  • Based in region with willingness to travel for customer engagements

You might excel if you…

  • Have owned technical evaluations at a developer-platform / API-first company — POCs/POVs you scoped and ran that ended in a customer going live

  • Have led engineers and want to move toward the customer, or are an SE who wants to be more hands-on than your last role allowed

  • Are genuinely curious about AI and have built things with LLMs — side projects count

  • Are energized by being the first: first hire, first deal, first playbook in a region

  • Have run enterprise evaluations end-to-end — POC success criteria, security questionnaires, RFP responses

  • Speak additional regional languages (a plus across APJ markets)

 

This is an in-person opportunity in London. In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Maintenance Lead
Billingham (Home of McCoy’s, Wheat Crunchies, pombear and more…) 
On-site | Monday - Friday

Join our snack-loving team
We’re looking for a Maintenance Lead to join us at KP Snacks. If you’re ready to bring your ideas to the table, grow your skills and be part of a team that values what makes you, you – this could be your next big move.

Who are we?
We’re KP Snacks, part of the Intersnack family. Across more than 30 countries, over 15,000 of us work together to make the snacks people love – from Hula Hoops to McCoy’s. In the UK, we’re a team of around 2,400 colleagues, based across seven sites and our Slough HQ. We’re proud of our close-knit culture, where we speak up, celebrate differences and push boundaries together.

About the role

This is a key leadership role within our production operation, where you'll act as the lead Maintenance Engineer for your production line and play a critical part in driving performance, reliability and continuous improvement. Working as part of a close-knit line leadership team, you'll take ownership of maintenance planning, scheduling and execution, ensuring equipment operates safely and efficiently to support operational performance.

You'll lead preventative and corrective maintenance activities, develop and deliver maintenance plans, and use data and root cause analysis to reduce downtime and improve equipment reliability. You'll also coach and support colleagues, champion engineering standards and work closely with Production, Technical and Engineering teams to achieve shared goals.

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with excellent planning and leadership skills, and who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

What’s in it for you?
We believe in rewarding our colleagues and helping them thrive. Here’s a flavour of what we offer:

  • Competitive annual salary

  • KP Pension Plan with up to 7% matched contributions

  • 25 days holiday, with the option to buy up to five additional days for more flexibility

  • Comprehensive healthcare support including Health Cash Plan, Digital GP and Employee Assistance Programme

  • KP4ME benefits platform with discounts, cashback, wellbeing tools and everyday savings

  • Enhanced family-friendly policies to support colleagues at every stage of life

What will you be doing?

  • Leading maintenance planning and execution
    Take ownership of maintenance activities for your production line, ensuring preventative and corrective work is planned, prioritised and completed effectively

  • Driving equipment reliability and performance
    Review line performance, analyse incidents and equipment stops, and implement solutions that improve reliability and reduce downtime

  • Managing maintenance schedules and work orders
    Develop weekly, monthly and annual maintenance plans, ensuring work orders are appropriately prioritised, tracked and completed

  • Championing engineering excellence
    Maintain technical documentation, support compliance with engineering standards and promote best practice across the operation

  • Coaching and collaborating with others
    Work closely with Production, Technical and Engineering colleagues while supporting the development and capability of the wider maintenance team


We’d love to hear from you if you can bring:

  • Strong engineering qualifications and technical expertise

  • NVQ Level 3, ONC, HNC or equivalent qualification in an electrical, electro-mechanical or mechanical engineering discipline, alongside an 18th Edition qualification.

  • Proven maintenance and fault-finding experience
    Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills gained within a manufacturing or FMCG environment

  • Knowledge of automation and continuous improvement
    Experience working with PLC-controlled equipment and Lean manufacturing tools and techniques

  • A strong focus on safety and compliance
    Knowledge of COSHH requirements and safe systems of work, with a commitment to maintaining high standards

  • Leadership and coaching capability
    The ability to influence, develop and support others while taking ownership of performance and results

Our purpose
At KP Snacks, we're passionate about creating happy snacking moments through our great tasting snacks and iconic brands. Every day, millions of people enjoy our products, including Hula Hoops, McCoy's, KP Nuts, Tyrrells, Skips, POM-BEAR and Butterkist, making us one of the UK's leading snack manufacturers.

For decades, we've been delighting consumers by combining well-loved favourites with exciting innovations that reflect changing tastes and expectations. We're equally passionate about our people and committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow, develop and make a real impact.

As part of the Intersnack Group, one of the world's leading snack manufacturers, we combine global expertise with a shared commitment to creating happy snacking moments every day.

We’re committed to inclusion
We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. If you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you – your unique perspective could be just what we need. And if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you, just let us know.

data.title: Senior Director, People & Culture
data.description:
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT BUILDING LEADERS, SHAPING CULTURE, AND ENABLING BUSINESS SUCCESS

The Senior Director, People & Culture is a pivotal senior role within our London Office and a key member of Catapult's global P&C leadership team. Working three days in the office and partnering closely with senior business leaders, you will drive strategic impact while shaping both the culture and operational effectiveness of the EMEA region.

Reporting to the Vice President, People & Culture, based in Melbourne, you will lead an in-region team of three and be responsible for designing and implementing strategies that enable, engage, develop and retain exceptional talent.

Success in this role requires a balance of strategic thinking and practical execution. You will thrive in a fast-paced, global environment and be energised by creating innovative, scalable solutions that strengthen leadership capability and foster a high-performance culture across the region.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Develop and execute strategic workforce plans, coaching senior leaders on organisational design, change management, communication, and talent development to drive engagement, retention, and business performance.
  • Shape culture and values by identifying organisational needs and implementing impactful, scalable people solutions.
  • Drive a consistent, high-quality employee experience across the EMEA region, spanning three offices, 16 countries, and multiple employment frameworks.
  • Provide hands-on support and strategic partnership to leaders, teams, and employees, ensuring people strategies are aligned with business goals.
  • Partner with the Talent team to deliver strategic initiatives across learning and development, diversity, equity and inclusion, reward, workforce planning, and talent acquisition.
  • Mentor and lead regional P&C team members, fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Leverage data and insights to identify trends, inform decision-making, and influence strategic outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • A commercial mindset and the ability to connect people decisions to business outcomes, building credibility and influence with senior leaders across regions and cultures.
  • Significant People & Culture leadership experience in a multi-country EMEA environment, with working knowledge of UK and German employment law.
  • Proven success partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced, high-growth, global organisation to drive transformation and business outcomes.
  • The ability to balance competing priorities across the employee lifecycle without compromising quality or attention to detail.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing clarity, structure, and momentum to complex challenges.
  • A strategic yet hands-on approach, balancing pace with employee development, engagement, and belonging.
  • Experience designing creative, commercially driven solutions to complex business challenges.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the organisation.
  • High levels of energy, adaptability, and resilience, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • A passion for creating a market-leading employee experience and fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Flexibility to work across global time zones when required.

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months, you have built strong relationships with senior leaders and key stakeholders and are recognised as a trusted P&C partner. You have a clear understanding of workforce opportunities, challenges, and priorities, with a defined view of how P&C can enable business performance. Your direct team is aligned on priorities, ways of working, and expectations, and regional P&C processes are operating with consistency and quality.
  • In 12 months time, you are driving meaningful impact through strategic workforce initiatives, stronger leadership capability, and an enhanced employee experience. Leaders are empowered to navigate people challenges effectively, global P&C initiatives are successfully embedded across teams, and data and insights are being used to inform decisions. You are a valued member of the global P&C leadership team, helping shape and deliver a high-performance culture across Catapult.

 

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box.
