data.title: Senior Data Analyst  (Marketing Analytics)
data.description:
What is the job?

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics to help us uncover what’s truly driving growth, understand where the biggest opportunities lie and shape where we focus next.

This is a high-impact, hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who loves getting under the skin of the data, connecting the dots behind performance and turning complex findings into clear, commercially meaningful action. You’ll be equally excited by the technical side of analytics - working with data, tools and reporting infrastructure - as you are by solving real business problems and influencing decisions.

Working closely with teams across paid media, CRM and lifecycle marketing, you’ll become a trusted partner to the wider marketing function. You’ll help us understand how our channels and campaigns are performing, identify the behaviours and trends that matter, and provide the insight needed to make smarter decisions about investment, optimisation and growth.

This is much more than a reporting role. You’ll challenge assumptions, ask the questions others may not have considered and bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. You’ll help shape how we measure success, improve the quality and accessibility of our marketing data, and build a stronger understanding of the full customer journey.

We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded and confident working independently. You’ll be comfortable setting your own direction, prioritising the work that will create the greatest value and getting on with delivering meaningful, measurable impact.

What will you be doing?

  • Partner with marketing teams to provide clear, actionable insights on performance across channels including Google, Meta, Social and CRM.

  • Analyse marketing spend and outcomes to support optimisation and better decision-making.

  • Own and evolve our GA4 setup, ensuring tracking is robust and focused on meaningful performance metrics.

  • Work with CRM teams to analyse lifecycle journeys, retention, and engagement using a variety of data sources.

  • Act as the internal owner for marketing data requirements, working with Analytics Engineers to ensure data models and dashboards meet real business needs.

  • Lead the development of advanced measurement, beyond basic attribution, moving from LTV and CAC towards incrementality.

  • Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, presentations, and conversations with senior stakeholders.

What do you need?

  • Experience with digital analytics, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-focused environment.

  • Hands-on experience with SQL is a must, BigQuery, GA4, Looker, and Google Sheets are a plus. Comfortable working across a broad marketing function and building strong relationships with non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience collaborating with data or analytics engineering teams, clearly defining requirements and translating insight into action.

  • A confident communicator who can explain complex analysis in simple, practical terms. You’re able to identify the what and the why to help shape decisions.

  • Self-starter mindset - able to navigate ambiguity and work independently.

  • Experience with Braze or similar CRM platforms is a strong advantage.

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. data.title: Mid-Market Account Executive, London
data.description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Open to hiring remote in London, UK.

 

You will carry a book of 40-60 mid-market and emerging accounts - companies in the <$1B range, closing 25-40 deals a year at $40k-$100k and building toward larger standard deal sizes as our packaging moves upmarket. You work in a pod with a dedicated Mid-Market Engagement Manager on a shared book, with a comp plan designed to maximize earnings and customer value.

 

We are architecting the best GTM team in all of AI. If you want to grow, run fast, and sell with a leading-edge frontier AI company with room to grow your career, please apply.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Run a high-velocity full-cycle motion: 25-40 closed deals a year across inbound and outbound

  • Qualify hard and fast - your book is big, your calendar is the scarce resource, orientation to clear ROI and value orientation is a must

  • Push deal size up: committed-volume, use-case expansion plays that turn $30k starts into $100k+ repeatable motions

  • Turn product signals (usage spikes, team signups, credit burn) into pipeline

  • Work with your pod's Engagement Manager so new customers hit consumption targets and your held-back commission unlocks

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 3+ years of full-cycle closing experience in SaaS/AI with a quota record above 100%

  • Velocity evidence: 20+ closed deals a year, multi-channel prospecting, disciplined qualification

data.title: B2B Sales Associate
data.description:
The Company:

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.

With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of events, memberships, and learning products, we help individuals and teams grow faster in their careers. We work with some of the world’s most recognisable companies and pride ourselves on being a high-impact learning partner, not just another events business.

We’re ambitious, we move quickly, and we’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, a steep learning curve, and plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

About the Role

We’re hiring early-career Sales Associates to join our Delegate & Membership sales team, people with energy, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in commercial roles.

This is a junior role by design. You don’t need years of experience, what matters most is how quickly you learn, how well you take feedback, and how comfortable you are being challenged. We’ll teach you how to sell properly: how to prospect, qualify, handle objections, manage a pipeline, and close, all while speaking to senior decision-makers at some of the world’s biggest tech companies.

You’ll sell across our live events, memberships, and learning solutions in markets including London, New York, San Francisco, Las Vegas and beyond. Over time, this role can progress into more senior sales or specialist commercial paths across the business.

This role is not about arriving fully formed, it’s about building and proving confidence, capability, and momentum through doing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Sales Upskilling: You’ll build strong foundations in prospecting, qualification, pipeline management, and closing, while learning how to sell confidently to senior B2B stakeholders and work to clear targets and expectations.

  • Engaging decision-makers: You’ll speak directly with professionals at fast-growing and enterprise tech companies, understand their challenges, and recommend the right events, memberships, and learning solutions.

  • Owning deals end-to-end: You’ll own your pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week.

  • Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling.

  • Collaboration & feedback: You’ll work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support.

This Role Is For You If

  • You’re early in your career and hungry to learn, not entitled to results

  • You’re comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new

  • You actively seek feedback and apply it quickly

  • You take ownership for outcomes, not just effort

  • You’re resilient, organised, and able to manage pace and pressure

  • You communicate clearly with customers and with teammates

  • You enjoy working as part of a team where success is shared

Our Hiring Process

Our hiring process is designed to reflect how we actually work: collaborative, practical, and focused on potential rather than polish.

  • First interview (values, motivation, and learning mindset)

  • One-day assessment in our London office (practical exercises, collaboration, and real-world sales scenarios)

  • Final shortlist: up to 3 candidates selected into an onboarding cohort, starting together and learning side-by-side

This process helps us understand how you think, learn, and show up — not just how well you interview.

Compensation: Base Salary £26,500 - 28,000 *range depending on experience

Commissions:
Year 1 OTE £35,000 uncapped
Year 2 OTE £55,000 uncapped

_________________________________

Benefits

Time off & flexibility

  • 34 days’ paid holiday including UK Bank holidays and a day off on your birthday

  • Flexible working hours: our core hours are 10am–4:30pm, with the flexibility to structure your working day between 8am and 8pm around when you work best

  • Work from where works for you: choose to work remotely within the UK or hybrid from our London office. Our office is always open to the wider team whenever you fancy coming in

  • WFH Kit: a comprehensive tech setup, plus a dedicated WFH equipment budget

  • A well-stocked office: snacks, drinks and fresh fruit available in our London office

Health & wellbeing

  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance with Bupa

  • Life Insurance: cover worth 4x your annual salary

  • On-demand therapy & coaching: company sponsored access to therapy and career coaching through Spill

  • Wellness perks: discounts on gym memberships, fitness and wellness classes

  • Cycle to Work & Workplace Nursery schemes

  • Perks at Work: access to a wide range of corporate discounts

  • Monthly flexible benefits allowance through ThanksBen (£50/month in year one, £100/month in year two and £165/month from year three), giving you extra flexibility to spend on the benefits that matter most to you

Learning & development

  • A growing personal L&D budget (starting at £500 per year and increasing with tenure to £3,000 per year)

  • Dedicated L&D or volunteering time: one paid day every quarter to invest in your development or support a cause you care about.

  • Unlimited access to our internal Academy: including courses, learning resources and professional certifications

Community and Inclusion

We are committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, and where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute. We acknowledge that our work here is never done - and we promise to continue striving for inclusivity every day.

If you’re worried you don’t quite hit all the requirements we’ve listed, don’t let that hold you back from submitting your application! Unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential for our ability to innovate and grow, so if you think you’d be a great fit then we’d love to hear from you.

We are The Alliance - in more ways than one.

Compensation: £26.5K – £28K • £10K – £20K Commission

data.title: Lead Product Designer
data.description:
Lead Product Designer - Cortex

📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)

💰 Competitive salary, dependent on experience

 

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.

 

Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it.

 

We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business.

 

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

  • At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them.

  • Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

  • We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

 

Here's what you can expect to be working on

  • Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user.

  • Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context.

  • Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it.

  • Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like.

  • Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast.

 

You should apply if:

  • You've built or shaped agentic AI, not just used AI tools - multi-step, tool-using agents you've designed, prototyped or shipped. You understand how they work and where they break.

  • You've got a well-formed point of view on agentic UX - how you design for systems that don't always behave the same way, how you build in trust, transparency and control, and when to keep a human in the loop.

  • You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it.

  • You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief.

  • You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after.

 

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly.

  • You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment.

  • You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon.

  • You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it.

 

A bit about you

  • AI & agentic depth: Non-negotiable, and the first thing we'll screen for. Current, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, with real examples of what you've built or shaped.

  • Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach.

  • Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain.

  • Ambiguity: You do your best work when the problem isn't yet defined.

  • Cross-functional: A peer at the table with product and engineering, partnering closely with a good PM without treading on each other's toes.

  • Technical fluency: Being hands-on enough to prototype with code is a real advantage here, given how close design sits to how these systems work. It's a plus, not a hard requirement.

  • Experience: Typically this comes with around 8+ years in product/UX design at senior IC level - but we care more about evidence you can operate at Lead altitude than the exact number, especially given how new agentic AI is. SaaS or complex product experience is helpful; property experience isn't required.

 

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application.

 

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week

🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)

💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth

📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development

🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away

🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us

👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay

🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured

🧘 Regular well-being initiatives

🕒 Flexible working hours

🚂 Public transport season ticket loans

🌷 Paid menopause leave

🌞 Holiday buying scheme

🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition

👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day

👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology

🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!

🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon

🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours

🚴 Cycle to work scheme

🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme

🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

 

Salary

We're not publishing a fixed band for this one. We'll build the package around your experience and the scope you bring, so please apply and let's have the conversation.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

 

Interview Process

3 stages = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Technical Interview inc. a Design & AI Task with our Head of UX > Final interview with our Co-Founder.

 

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

 

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don't want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we're hiring

  • We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled operators like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

  • We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

  • Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we’ll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.

  • The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.

  • We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

  • The operational machine behind Odin is still held together in many places by people and spreadsheets. Your job is to come in, understand every process and system, simplify, streamline and automate the shit out of it.

  • You’ll be part of a small elite team embedded in operations and working closely with existing team members to build agents that automate work.

  • We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else.

What you'll own

  • Understand the work, then rebuild it: You’ll get close to how our operational teams actually work - the processes, edge cases, manual steps and things that slow them down. Your job is to understand them well enough to redesign, automate and build better ways of doing them.

  • Build and automate: You’ll turn manual workflows into tools, automations and systems that make the business faster and more scalable. You’ll work autonomously and move quickly - often vibe coding something useful yourself before it ever needs traditional product or engineering resource.

  • Bridge operations and engineering: You’ll know when something can be solved with process, automation or a lightweight build, and when it genuinely needs deeper engineering work. When it does, you’ll bring Product, Design and Engineering in with the problem already understood, simplified and proven.

  • Delete things and say no: You’ll constantly question why a process exists, whether a request should be supported, and whether something is worth scaling. If a workflow exists for no good reason, you kill it. If a request creates complexity without enough value, we don’t do it.

What we're looking for

  • AI-pilled builder: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built concrete solutions to problems with no budget and no engineers. No-code tooling, scripts, spreadsheets, vibe-coded apps and more.

  • Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You’ll be working on automating a lot of numerical matters - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting.

  • In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done.

  • First principles thinker: Although you're in the details and on top of execution, you also zoom out. You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal?
    A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that.

  • Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. SQL, serious Excel and other experience piping data between systems are all worth having too. However, we care much more about the traits you have and things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV. If you're a few years into your career and you've already automated the shit out of your last job or built something incredible with AI, we want to talk to you.

  • You want to operate, not manage: Odin is not a place for middle management. We all get shit done, regardless of title or seniority

How we work

There are five things we care about deeply:

  1. Reason from the ground up: Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

  2. Speed begets speed: We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

  3. Take ownership: Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

  4. Brutal honesty: If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to.

  5. Truly excellent customer service: Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster.

This role is probably not for you if

  • You'd rather build product than operate. Product instinct is required in this role, but a product management career is not what this is;

  • You prefer close management of your responsibilities;

  • You are risk-averse;

  • You want a 9-5;

  • You take yourself too seriously;

  • You care about working for a company that’s raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact

Salary

£70k - £90k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity.

Hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one.

Location & ways of working

We're a London-based team. This role works closely with the founders, product and the wider ops team, and the speed we run at makes that much easier in-person. At least three days a week in the office.

Benefits

  • Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support

  • Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness

  • Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave

  • Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options

  • Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total)

  • Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally

  • Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave

data.title: Quantum Information Scientist - Architecture & Performance
data.description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. 

Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so.

About this position:

You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture, working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 

Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints. You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices.

Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas. You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team.

Requirements

What you'll do:

As a Quantum Information Scientist working on Architecture & Performance, you will: 

  • Evaluate and compare the capabilities and limitations of near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 
  • Draw on methods from complexity theory, benchmarking, characterisation and related fields to assess different architecture designs. 
  • Incorporate realistic noise, native operations and physical constraints into your analyses. 
  • Investigate when and how different architectures could provide meaningful computational capabilities or advantages. 
  • Develop scientific models and numerical tools to explore architecture-performance trade-offs. 
  • Study how architecture choices interact with algorithms, resource requirements and QEC strategies. 
  • Progressively propose and lead new research projects around architecture design and performance. 

You will work across our Architecture team and Algorithms and Applications team, connecting questions from the physical layer to computational capability and potential applications. 
-

How you'll grow:

During your first 3–6 months 
Become familiar with Quandela’s technologies, architecture roadmap and ongoing research while contributing to existing evaluation and performance studies. 

Within 1 year 
Take increasing ownership of architecture studies, compare different concepts and bring your own scientific perspective to the team. 

Longer term 
Lead exploratory research projects, propose new architecture directions and contribute to shaping Quandela’s future architecture roadmap.

--

What we're looking for:
We are looking for a scientist with a strong theoretical background in quantum computing, scientific autonomy and an interest in connecting different layers of the quantum-computing stack.

Must-have 

  • PhD in Quantum Information, Quantum Computing, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a closely related field. 
  • Strong expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as quantum complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, performance analysis or quantum algorithms. 
  • Experience connecting theoretical or computational questions with realistic implementation, hardware or experimental constraints. 
  • Ability to assess the capabilities and limitations of quantum systems or architectures. 
  • Experience with scientific modelling, numerical simulation and Python-based scientific computing. 
  • Scientific autonomy and ability to structure open-ended research problems.
  • Collaborative and personable, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to people from other fields of expertise.
  • Professional English. 

Important, but you can grow here 

  • Quantum Error Correction and early fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Hardware-aware algorithm or architecture design. 
  • Quantum benchmarking and performance metrics. 
  • Noise modelling. 
  • Resource and computational-cost analysis. 
  • Collaboration with experimental or hardware-oriented quantum-computing teams. 

Bonus 

  • Quantum compilation or native-gate-aware circuit design. 
  • Photonic quantum computing. 
  • Resource estimation. 
  • Experience comparing quantum approaches against strong classical baselines. 
  • Previous ownership of collaborative research projects. 

You do not need to cover every topic above. We welcome both candidates with postdoctoral or equivalent industrial R&D experience and strong recent PhDs demonstrating scientific autonomy.

Benefits

Join a growing quantum-computing company and contribute directly to the research behind future generations of quantum architectures. 

  • Explore open scientific questions grounded in real hardware constraints. 
  • Work across Quantum Information, Device Physics, FTQC and Algorithms. 
  • Take ownership of broad and exploratory research projects. 
  • Contribute to the scientific directions of a growing team. 

Plus: 

  • Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and level of responsibility. 
  • Company savings plan.
  • 100% health coverage through Alan. 
  • Transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus. 
  • Swile meal vouchers. 
  • Access to Gymlib. 

Process

data.title: Quantum Information Scientist - Architecture & Performance
data.description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. 

Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so.

About this position:

You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture, working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 

Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints. You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices.

Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas. You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team.

Requirements

What you'll do:

As a Quantum Information Scientist working on Architecture & Performance, you will: 

  • Evaluate and compare the capabilities and limitations of near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 
  • Draw on methods from complexity theory, benchmarking, characterisation and related fields to assess different architecture designs. 
  • Incorporate realistic noise, native operations and physical constraints into your analyses. 
  • Investigate when and how different architectures could provide meaningful computational capabilities or advantages. 
  • Develop scientific models and numerical tools to explore architecture-performance trade-offs. 
  • Study how architecture choices interact with algorithms, resource requirements and QEC strategies. 
  • Progressively propose and lead new research projects around architecture design and performance. 

You will work across our Architecture team and Algorithms and Applications team, connecting questions from the physical layer to computational capability and potential applications. 
-

How you'll grow:

During your first 3–6 months 
Become familiar with Quandela’s technologies, architecture roadmap and ongoing research while contributing to existing evaluation and performance studies. 

Within 1 year 
Take increasing ownership of architecture studies, compare different concepts and bring your own scientific perspective to the team. 

Longer term 
Lead exploratory research projects, propose new architecture directions and contribute to shaping Quandela’s future architecture roadmap.

--

What we're looking for:
We are looking for a scientist with a strong theoretical background in quantum computing, scientific autonomy and an interest in connecting different layers of the quantum-computing stack.

Must-have 

  • PhD in Quantum Information, Quantum Computing, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a closely related field. 
  • Strong expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as quantum complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, performance analysis or quantum algorithms. 
  • Experience connecting theoretical or computational questions with realistic implementation, hardware or experimental constraints. 
  • Ability to assess the capabilities and limitations of quantum systems or architectures. 
  • Experience with scientific modelling, numerical simulation and Python-based scientific computing. 
  • Scientific autonomy and ability to structure open-ended research problems.
  • Collaborative and personable, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to people from other fields of expertise.
  • Professional English. 

Important, but you can grow here 

  • Quantum Error Correction and early fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Hardware-aware algorithm or architecture design. 
  • Quantum benchmarking and performance metrics. 
  • Noise modelling. 
  • Resource and computational-cost analysis. 
  • Collaboration with experimental or hardware-oriented quantum-computing teams. 

Bonus 

  • Quantum compilation or native-gate-aware circuit design. 
  • Photonic quantum computing. 
  • Resource estimation. 
  • Experience comparing quantum approaches against strong classical baselines. 
  • Previous ownership of collaborative research projects. 

You do not need to cover every topic above. We welcome both candidates with postdoctoral or equivalent industrial R&D experience and strong recent PhDs demonstrating scientific autonomy.

Benefits

Join a growing quantum-computing company and contribute directly to the research behind future generations of quantum architectures. 

  • Explore open scientific questions grounded in real hardware constraints. 
  • Work across Quantum Information, Device Physics, FTQC and Algorithms. 
  • Take ownership of broad and exploratory research projects. 
  • Contribute to the scientific directions of a growing team. 

Plus:

data.title: Key Account Manager — Treasury Expert
data.description:
About Agicap

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

⚡️ Le rôle

Agicap est en pleine phase de scale-up : nous signons chaque mois de nombreux nouveaux clients, et développer et fidéliser nos clients existants est désormais tout aussi important. L'expansion et le churn font partie des premiers indicateurs suivis par notre board.

En tant que Key Account Manager, vous êtes responsable d'un portefeuille d'environ 150 comptes mid-market : des entreprises de plus de 50 M€ de chiffre d'affaires, souvent des groupes multi-entités, des sociétés en hypercroissance ou détenues par des fonds de private equity. Vous travaillez avec des DAF, directeur·rices financier·ères, trésorier·ères, responsables comptables et parfois des CEO.

Ce qui rend ce poste unique : vous apportez une vraie expertise en trésorerie. Vous ne vous contentez pas de comprendre les enjeux des équipes finance (maîtriser les prévisions de trésorerie, améliorer la performance financière, assurer la gestion quotidienne des paiements et de la liquidité, gérer la relation bancaire, intégrer et piloter toutes les entités d'un groupe) : vous savez les challenger. Vous êtes un·e véritable conseiller·ère de confiance pour vos clients.

Vous rejoignez une équipe de 7 KAM qui a obtenu d'excellents résultats cette année, avec un fort esprit d'équipe et des objectifs ambitieux.


🎯 Vos missions

🤝 Construire des relations solides avec les décideur·ses finance

  • Instaurer une relation de confiance avec les décideur·ses de vos comptes et cartographier toutes les parties prenantes clés, souvent sur plusieurs entités
  • Comprendre leur contexte business, leur organisation trésorerie, leurs process et leurs priorités, et les challenger avec les bonnes pratiques adaptées
  • Gérer les frictions et les situations complexes avec assurance

    • 📈 Développer votre portefeuille

    • Définir et piloter une stratégie de développement pour chaque compte : upsell, renouvellement, contrats pluriannuels, recommandation
    • Identifier de nouvelles opportunités : nouvelles entités, nouveaux cas d'usage, évolutions dans l'organisation ou le contexte business du client
    • Mener des découvertes et des démos produit centrées sur les cas d'usage trésorerie, construire des business cases et négocier les offres
    • Porter vos objectifs mensuels d'expansion et de rétention

      • 📊 Démontrer la valeur et sécuriser la rétention

      • Animer des Executive Business Reviews (EBR) pour vous aligner sur les enjeux stratégiques du client et mesurer son retour sur investissement
      • Détecter tôt les signaux faibles de churn et sauver les comptes à risque
      • Suivre et analyser votre performance avec votre manager pour progresser en continu

        • 🔗 Être la voix de la trésorerie chez Agicap

        • Trouver le bon équilibre entre la mise en avant du produit et le bon timing : notre produit évolue vite, à vous de fixer les bonnes attentes avec vos clients
        • Identifier les besoins d'activation ou de paramétrage et les transmettre à l'équipe Onboarding
        • Partager vos retours terrain avec les équipes CS et Produit pour améliorer nos process et notre produit

👀 Votre profil
  • Vous avez une solide expertise en trésorerie / cash management, acquise en direction trésorerie, en conseil, en banque ou chez un éditeur de logiciels trésorerie / finance
  • Vous savez expliquer et challenger des sujets comme les prévisions de trésorerie, le BFR, le cash pooling, la connectivité bancaire ou la consolidation multi-entités
  • Vous avez fait vos preuves dans un rôle client avec des objectifs commerciaux (account management, upsell, renouvellements ou business development), et vous savez mener une bonne découverte
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec des décideur·ses finance exigeant·es et vous savez conduire des négociations complexes
  • Vous êtes moteur de votre propre montée en compétences : résilient·e, vous aimez résoudre des problèmes et vous vous remettez en question en permanence
  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement qui va vite, où tout n'est pas encore parfait
  • Vous avez un fort esprit d'équipe et vous aimez partager vos connaissances
  • Vous parlez couramment français et anglais

    • ⭐️ Bonus : une expérience sur un TMS ou un ERP (Kyriba, SAP, Sage, Cegid…), une connaissance de l'environnement SaaS, de la rigueur dans l'utilisation d'un CRM (HubSpot / Salesforce)


🔥 Pourquoi rejoindre Agicap ?
  • Mettre votre expertise trésorerie au cœur d'un rôle commercial, avec un produit conçu pour les équipes finance
  • Rejoindre une équipe à fort impact, dans une phase clé de structuration : un gros challenge et une vraie contribution à apporter
  • Un package fixe + variable, qui récompense à la fois l'expansion et la rétention — à confirmer
  • Du travail hybride depuis nos bureaux de Lyon, avec 2 jours de télétravail par semaine
  • Rejoindre une entreprise en forte croissance, aux ambitions internationales (France, Royaume-Uni, Allemagne, Espagne, et maintenant les États-Unis)

⏳ Process de recrutement
  • Premier échange avec Eline, de l'équipe Talent Acquisition
  • Entretien 1 (visio) avec Myrtille, future manager
  • Entretien 2 (visio) : cas pratique avec Myrtille et Thomas, notre expert trésorerie
  • Entretien final dans nos bureaux de Lyon avec Philippe Cheron, Global COO
AGICAP s'engage à offrir des opportunités égales à tous, nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité!

À propos de Lexroom

Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café.

data.title: Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
data.description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.
  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery, DLP for AI tools, controls for AI assistants and agents, and a working risk framework for adopting new ones. You've done this for real, not from a vendor pitch deck.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills — you build tooling against APIs, not just configure consoles.
  • Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight. 
  • Сlear written and spoken English for engineers and leadership.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol office, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one. 
Enhance your expertise and shape the future of FinTech. Join Vivid's talented team and help us revolutionize how businesses think about their finances!


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started. 

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

Context

You'll join a tight-knit team with high product standards and direct access to production deployment: our models are tested in real-world conditions, with several million users each month, with very short cycles between prototyping, integration and deployment.

In this context, you'll work on the next generation of agentic and recommendation systems: building the pipelines, agents, and models that sit at the core of our product.

Your goal is to build and scale the agentic infrastructure that powers Lemrock's commerce intelligence: turning raw signals into automated, self-improving systems at production scale.

data.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

We write a lot, and it's read by millions of people around the world. Our content team is already strong, and now we want to make it stronger. You'll be the native voice of the brand: everything our users read will go through you.

What you will work on

  • Reviewing and editing the team's copy across the blog, Help Center, changelog, Creator Hub, case studies, PR and news, newsletters, product updates, and UI text;

  • Fact-checking every piece before it ships: checking model and feature names against the product;

  • Keeping facts consistent across every surface, so the same number reads the same in the blog, Help Center, landing pages, and press releases;

  • Shaping content for AI answers: a direct answer up front, question-based headings, useful FAQs, and internal links;

  • Keeping the writing alive and human, with no traces of AI or template-speak;

  • Working on tone, rhythm and clarity, not just fixing grammar;

  • Writing your own pieces too, including editorial work like our Inside Higgsfield series;

  • Holding one consistent brand voice across everything we publish.

Your must haves

  • English as your native language;

  • A strong background in editing and writing, with a portfolio to show for it;

  • An instinct for style, tone and rhythm. You feel when a sentence works and when it doesn't;

  • The ability to explain your edits and how they make the text stronger. "It sounds better" is a start, not an answer;

  • An owner mindset: you see what could be better, and you make it happen;

  • Comfort with startup pace. We move fast, ship weekly, and the writing has to keep up.

Nice to have

  • Experience editing for a tech, SaaS or AI product;

  • Experience building or maintaining a style guide or brand voice;

  • Familiarity with the GenAI landscape and the tools creators actually use;

The deal

  • Competitive salary in USD;

  • Fully remote position;

  • Access to Higgsfield products and the AI tools we use internally;

  • Full-time position with high ownership and growth potential.

data.title: Customer Care Team Lead
data.description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

Day One: Hands-On Frontline Support

  • Frontline Excellence: Personally resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat and phone, delivering high-touch support from day one.

  • Internal Product Mastery: Act as our expert power user, testing our internal OS and advocating for tool improvements that boost operational efficiency.

  • NPS & Proactive Care: Design proactive care initiatives to ensure member satisfaction remains consistently best-in-class.

Post-Ramp: Team Scale & Process

  • Team Scaling & Playbooks: Build, mentor, and lead a growing support team while writing our core SOPs, escalation pathways, and training guides.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Turn daily support interactions into structured insights that directly inform product roadmap decisions.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 2+ years in high-volume B2C customer care or support, with a track record of mentoring peers and a readiness to step into your first formal lead role.

  • Bilingual Skills: Fluent in both English and French (written and spoken).

  • People-First Energy: You bring genuine warmth, high empathy, and enthusiasm to every interaction, turning routine support into remarkable member experiences.

  • Phone-First Instinct: You default to picking up the phone whenever a complex issue calls for a personal touch.

  • Rigorous Precision: Exceptional attention to detail with zero tolerance for misquotes, incorrect details, or operational errors.

Nice to have

  • Regulated Industry Experience: Prior background in healthtech, fintech, or another high-compliance consumer space where accuracy is critical.

  • Startup Mindset: Thrives in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution, and clear communication.

  • Modern Tooling: Practical experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and boost support efficiency.

 

The process

  • Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

  • Case study interview (30-60 min)

  • Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

  • Reference calls

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

data.title: Développeur Full Stack JS
data.description:
Demain, notre console recevra des milliards de requêtes. Votre mission : faire en sorte qu’elle tienne, et qu’elle reste rapide. Arkane Cloud crée un poste de Développeur Full Stack, à 80 % back-end, pour bâtir une plateforme taillée pour la charge.

 

Notre société

Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais qui rend la puissance de calcul IA accessible, abordable et disponible en quelques minutes. Grâce à notre propre infrastructure composée de centaines de GPU, startups, chercheurs et entreprises déploient leurs modèles d’IA sans se battre avec la technique.

  • Jusqu’à 70 % d’économies par rapport à un hyperscaler

  • Une plateforme Plug & Play prête en moins de 3 minutes.

Notre ambition : bâtir un acteur européen de référence de l’infrastructure IA.

 

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Notre console est le point d’entrée de nos clients : c’est là qu’ils déploient et pilotent leurs ressources GPU. Avec l’essor de l’IA, elle va devoir absorber une très grande quantité de requêtes. Nous créons ce poste pour la rendre robuste face aux pics de charge, développer les API qui la font tourner et installer les bonnes pratiques qui permettront à l’équipe de grandir. Votre temps se partage à 80 % sur le back-end et 20 % sur le front-end.

 

Vos missions

• Tenir les pics de charge : une architecture qui absorbe le trafic sans ralentir.

• Développer nos API en Node.js : performantes, sécurisées, documentées.

• Installer les bonnes pratiques : revues de code, tests automatisés, monitoring.

• Optimiser la base de données PostgreSQL.

• Faire évoluer l’interface de la console en React.js (environ 20 % du temps).

 

Vos 6 premiers mois

1er mois : Prise en main de la console et de son architecture, premier audit de performance, premières mises en production.

3 mois : Tests de charge en place, premiers points de blocage corrigés, bonnes pratiques formalisées.

6 mois : Console capable d’absorber n'importe quelle montée en charge, monitoring et alertes opérationnels.

 

Votre expérience

• 5 ans ou plus en développement, avec une dominante back-end.

• Une expérience sur une plateforme grand public ou à fort trafic.

Vos expertises

• Node.js : conception d’API robustes et performantes.

• React.js : à l’aise pour faire évoluer une interface existante.

• Montée en charge : cache, files d’attente, tests de charge, scalabilité.

Un vrai plus :

Playwright, Grafana, connaissance du cloud ou des infrastructures GPU.

Votre façon de travailler : rigoureux sur la qualité, pragmatique, à l’aise pour partager vos pratiques avec l’équipe.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

• Un vrai défi technique : S'assurer de la robuste de la plateforme lors des montées en charge

• Un impact direct : Vos choix d’architecture façonnent la plateforme.

• Des standards à poser : c’est vous qui fixez le niveau d’exigence de l’équipe.

• Au cœur de l’IA : vos API pilotent une infrastructure GPU dédiée à l’IA.

 

Package et avantages

• Télétravail 3 jours par semaine, présence au bureau de Lyon le mercredi et le jeudi

• Mutuelle à 100 %, tickets restaurant, RTT (Convention Syntec)

• Choix du matériel (PC ou Mac) & BSPCE

 

Arkane Cloud s’engage pour la diversité : nous étudions toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’âge, d’origine ou de handicap.

 

Compensation: €45K – €65K

6 mois : nouveau site en ligne, premiers composants du design system et premières améliorations de la console.

 

Votre expérience

data.title: Director, Business Development
data.description:
About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

  • Minimum 3–7 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record in new business development

  • Experience selling , multi-service solutions to corporate clients — ideally in one or more of the following: creative services, digital production, marketing services, SaaS/tech, or professional services

  • Proven ability to close six-figure deals and manage multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in creative industries (luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, advertising) — a strong differentiator

  • Experience navigating large organisations — identifying budget holders, managing procurement processes, and building internal champions

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Hunter profile— proactive, autonomous, energised by opening new doors

  • Ability to sell both transactional and strategic engagements depending on client maturity

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills— listens before pitching

  • Comfortable discussing technology, AI, and workflow solutions as well as creative services

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in both French and English

You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams.

You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room.


Your tasks include:

  • Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations.
  • Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders.
  • Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases.
  • Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions.
  • Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples.
  • Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity.
  • Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides.


Your profile

You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff.


Experience & Education

  • More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement.
  • Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences.
  • Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns.
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud.
  • Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus.
  • Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example Paris).
  • Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%).
  • Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock).
  • Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations.
  • Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies.

Skills & Attributes

  • Explains cloud and AI concepts clearly to engineers, architects and business stakeholders alike.
  • Facilitates live technical labs and solves setup, code and API issues on the spot.
  • Strong executive presence and professional conduct with senior partner stakeholders.
  • Adapts content and communication style to different proficiency levels, regions and roles.
  • Reads, explains and lightly modifies sample code in Python or JavaScript.
  • Understands RAG, vector search, AI agents and workflow orchestration well enough to teach them.
  • Of advantage: experience with developer relations, sales engineering enablement or solution architect training.


Why us?

You teach AI to the people who bring it to enterprise customers, with a premium learner experience as the standard.

Impact: Your sessions build the technical confidence that drives AI adoption across partner field teams in EMEA.

Responsibility: You own the delivery quality of your workshops and represent a leading AI company directly with strategic partners.

Dynamics: AI products change fast, and so does your content; you work in a small team that decides quickly.

Development: Product training and credentialing are provided, and you grow into a specialist role in a new, high-visibility training program.


Benefits

  • Home office option
  • Flexible working hours
  • Fitness subsidy
  • Apple hardware (laptop & iPhone)


These are the recruiting steps that await you:

  1. Culture Fit - Get to know Rike or Kim from our People team. Learn more about nonplusultra and our culture.
  2. Content & Role Fit Interview - Go deeper into the role with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.
  3. Case Study - Work through a practical training scenario together with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.

WeCreate ist eine Social-First Brand Building Agency für das Interest-Media-Zeitalter. Wir übersetzen Social Signals und Community Insights in Social Strategien, Content-Systeme und messbare Markenwirkung – als strategischer Partner, Campaign Co-Pilot oder operatives Umsetzungsteam. 

Für Marken, die nicht nur stattfinden, sondern kulturell und in ihren Communities relevant sein wollen, suchen wir dich als Senior Creative Strategist (all genders).

Du verbindest strategische Klarheit mit kreativer Führung. Als strategische Stimme von WeCreate entwickelst du die Marken- und Plattformlogik unserer Kund:innen, übersetzt sie in wirksame Content-Systeme und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten Idee ein konsistenter, relevanter und plattformnativer Content-Output wird.


Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest die strategische und kreative Gesamtausrichtung komplexer Kunden-Mandate von der Social Marken-Positionierung über Plattform- und Kanalstrategien bis zur übergreifenden Content-Systematik und Qualitätssicherung über alle Projektphasen hinweg.

Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig auf Senior-Level, triffst Entscheidungen mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und kommunizierst sicher mit den Marken-Entscheider:innen. data.title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)
data.description:
Role description

As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.


Your Mission

  • Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
  • Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success 
  • Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead.
  • Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.
  • Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables.
  • Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress.
  • Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit.
  • Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1).
  • Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
  • IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment.
  • Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation.


Why you'll love working here

  • Exciting tasks in an internationally operating, growing family business with flat hierarchies
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model
  • 4 weeks remote work from other EU countries
  • 30 days paid vacation per year
  • Salary bands for a fair corporate culture
  • Monthly allowance of €50 for your BAV
  • Annual 360° feedback loops with clear promotion criteria and an individual career path
  • Responsibility from day one in a company that encourages personal responsibility and growth
  • Relocation costs can be reimbursed on a pro rata basis
  • Regular company events such as summer party, Christmas party
  • Paid team dinners or activities for each team twice a year
  • Free parking right outside the door
  • Perks and benefits: JobRad, subsidized lunch, subsidy for the Deutschlandticket, free language courses and discounted memberships at several gyms and for the Wellpass
  • Fresh fruit, free drinks and snacks in the office
